brief:
Climate activist Greta Thunberg highlighted what she called an "uncomfortable contradiction" at COP proceedings, linking Turkish energy shipments to the conflict in Palestine, Middle East Eye reported. Activists cited a report documenting 77 oil shipments departing Turkish ports in connection with the matter.

The remarks point to broader activist concerns about fossil fuel trade continuing amid the Palestinian conflict, though complete details of the shipment report and Thunberg's specific statements were not fully provided in available summaries.

title: Thunberg links Turkish energy exports to Palestinian genocide at COP
